- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Organic and non-GMO products typically command higher prices than conventionally-produced products, leading to higher profit margins for farmers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Small-scale farmers face challenges in competing due to the costs associated with organic and non-GMO certification.

- [USER] User asked if there could be solutions to help small-scale farmers compete in the market.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested solutions for small-scale farmers include offering financial assistance, investing in local and regional food systems, providing education and training, and fostering partnerships and collaborations.

- [USER] User inquired if consumers have a role in supporting small-scale farmers.
